payload.claim: The docstring's closing citation '(DESIGN.md §5.5, §5.6)' is attached to the claim that a `findings.json` no older than `gates/` belongs to the latest run. That timing behavior (export/recreate of the `gates/` directory once per run) is established in `saffron/cell/session.py` and `saffron/repos/mirror.py`, not in DESIGN.md's REVIEW/REBUT sections, so the citation does not point at text that actually supports the sentence it closes.
